title: Dock: app icons against shelf-2
about: The dock's app icons (pixel mode) against the approved shelf-2 dock (mockups/shelf-2.html): nine v4 apps the desktop ships, in a row with shelf-2's 8 px gap, cropped to the icons' 40 px row. The dock island's surface is the Shell's material, kept as material with each icon kept as art.
